column1: # One row per (role, group).  `product` is the whole patch, cap included: `[#0:20]` is the R marker the
# cut leaves behind, and 20 is the map number every row gives it, so the enumerator finds the marker by
# number rather than by scanning.  The site the cap hangs off states `@=`, since a cut takes no
# configuration away with the fragment that leaves and a patch otherwise drops the configuration at its
# own reaction centre.  An empty `example` means "use the group's own example".
